# Acme Docs

> Acme is a payments API. These docs cover setup, the REST API and the SDKs.

Pages are available as Markdown by appending `.md` to their URL.
All examples use the test mode keys.

## Getting started

- [Quickstart](https://docs.acme.test/quickstart.md): Take your first payment in five minutes
- [Authentication](https://docs.acme.test/auth.md): API keys and OAuth
- [Webhooks](https://docs.acme.test/webhooks.md)

## API reference

- [Payments](https://docs.acme.test/api/payments.md): Create, capture and refund payments
- [Customers](https://docs.acme.test/api/customers.md): Store customer details
- [Errors](https://docs.acme.test/api/errors.md): Error codes and retries

## Optional

- [Changelog](https://docs.acme.test/changelog.md): Every API version since 2019
- [Blog](https://acme.test/blog.md)
